g.text: TeamSpeak 3: voice for friends, with an offsite failover
Single replica on MetalLB with source IPs kept for bans. If the homelab is down, the client falls over by DNS.
so per-IP bans see real addresses
Terraform: A records and SRV records
UCG port-forwards are manual; KPN is never in IaC
Reply path: out through the node's second NIC (policy
routing) so the UCG's stateful NAT sees the answer.
Sources: docs/services/teamspeak.md, docs/procedures/offsite-do1.md. Failover is the standard client-side SRV fallback, no extra tooling.
